name: Realization of the ITS-90 from 0.65 K to 5.0 K by 3He/4He vapour-pressure thermometry in a vacuum-isolated copper block
plain_name: Set the temperature scale near absolute zero from the boiling pressure of liquid helium
description: Vapour-pressure bulbs sit in a copper block inside a vacuum jacket. Cooling comes from a 4He bath with a 1 K pot and dilution refrigerator, or from a closed-cycle cryostat.
keywords: Set the temperature scale near absolute zero from the boiling pressure of liquid helium

sources.citation: BIPM CCT Guide to the Realization of the ITS-90: Vapour Pressure Scales and Pressure Measurements (2018)

reported_equipment: Rusby and Swenson (1980) combined 3He/4He vapour-pressure cryostat
Engert et al. (2003, 2007) 3He vapour-pressure thermometer on a dilution refrigerator

requirements.rationale: The scale covers 0.65 K to 5.0 K.
The bulbs are suspended inside a vacuum jacket.
The reference systems use a liquid 4He bath; cryocoolers are an alternative.

confirmation_note: Requirements taken from the cited procedure and independently re-verified against the source (research/v4, 2026-11-01). Users must confirm them for their own run; edits require confirmation again.
